note: Shop registration subscription (owner brief 25-Nov-2026 02.02 IST; PR #557, migration 0210; docs/shop-registration-subscription-2026-11). TC-REGSUB-001…008 are signed-in checks in tests/qa/signed-in/registration-subscription.spec.ts (run on test.gokesari.com). 009…015 are covered by tests/integration/shop-registration-subscription.test.ts (Vitest, real PostgreSQL). 016…019 need a phone or the owner.

features.feature: Registration fee as a 1-year subscription: status, expiry, grace, reminders (EN+MR, 09.00 IST), payment links, admin screen with audited actions, owner card and banners, expired shops hidden

scenarios.title: A shop's registration is paid, reminded, renewed or expires
scenarios.description: An unpaid shop is reminded and pays by link; a paid shop is reminded before expiry, renews or goes into grace and then is hidden; staff change the expiry or record an offline payment, all audited.

cases.title: Unpaid & expiring registrations screen: filters and columns
cases.steps:
1. Open Admin → Shops → Unpaid & expiring registrations
2. Read the filter chips and the table headings
cases.expected: Filter chips Unpaid, Expiring in 30 days, 15 days, 7 days, Grace, Expired with counts; shop type, area and dealer code filters; columns shop, owner (phone, e-mail), type · dealer, registered, expiry, days left, status, amount due, last reminder, payment link, actions

cases.title: Registration list API: filters and CSV
cases.steps:
1. GET /api/admin/registration-subscription?filter=ALL
2. Same with filter=EXPIRING_30
3. Same with format=csv
cases.expected: 1: rows with status and counts per status; 2: only shops 0–30 days from expiry; 3: CSV with the brief's columns, mobiles masked to the last four digits

cases.title: Only admin and operator manage registrations; settings are admin only
cases.preconditions: Customer, shop owner, operator and admin sessions
cases.steps:
1. As customer and as shop owner: GET and POST /api/admin/registration-subscription, GET /api/admin/registration-subscription/settings
2. As operator: GET the list, GET settings

cases.title: Settings defaults of the brief
cases.expected: Validity 12 months, grace 7 days, unpaid reminders 1, 3, 7 then every 7 days, expiry reminders 30, 15, 7…0, grace daily, link validity 7 days, CC ceo@agtci.com, commission on renewals No, reminders hour 09 IST

cases.title: Shop Registration card on the dashboard
cases.steps:
1. Sign in as the shop owner, open /shop
2. Read the Shop Registration card
cases.expected: Card shows status, registration date, expiry date, days left, amount due and the Payment history link; no red banner while Active

cases.title: Expire now hides the shop from customers; restoring the date shows it again; audited with the reason
cases.preconditions: Shop B live with an expiry
cases.steps:
1. Admin: Expiry → Expire now with a reason
2. Guest: open /shops/<B slug>, search B's name
3. Admin: Set a date back to the old expiry
4. Guest: open the page again
5. Admin: History
cases.expected: 2: page not found, not in search; 4: page shows again; 5: two Expiry changed entries with who, when (IST), old and new expiry and the reason

cases.title: A reason is required to change the expiry; an active shop is skipped by Send reminder
cases.steps:
1. POST EXPIRY with an empty reason
2. POST REMIND for shop A
cases.expected: 1: 422, expiry unchanged; 2: sent 0, skipped with 'registration active — nothing due'

cases.title: Create payment link: a new link cancels the older one
cases.preconditions: Shop B live; sandbox gateway on staging
cases.steps:
1. POST LINK for shop B
2. POST LINK again
3. Read the list row
cases.expected: 1 and 2: link created with an amount; 3: one ACTIVE link (the second); the first is CANCELLED in History

cases.title: New registration payment starts 1 year from the payment date
cases.steps: Pay the registration fee of an unpaid shop
cases.expected: Status Active, start = payment date, expiry = start + 12 months

cases.title: Unpaid reminders day 1, 3, 7 then weekly, once a day from 09.00 IST, with an auto Pay Now link
cases.steps: Run the job for shops registered 1, 2, 3, 7, 10 and 14 days ago, twice
cases.expected: One reminder each on days 1, 3, 7, 14; none on 2 and 10; none twice; none before 09.00 IST

cases.title: Migration of existing shops and its report
cases.preconditions: Shops paid without an end date, paid over a year ago, never paid
cases.expected: Paid: +12 months from the first fee payment; past expiry: GRACE for 7 days; never paid: UNPAID; report counts per status

cases.title: Expiry reminders on 30, 15, each of the last 7 days, the expiry day, every grace day
cases.steps: Run the job across the expiry
cases.expected: E30, E15, E7…E0, G1…G6, X0 once each

cases.title: Gateway webhook: success activates once, failure changes nothing, a repeated capture adds nothing
cases.steps: Pay a link (success), repeat the capture, fail another
cases.expected: Active with one year; repeat: same expiry; failure: still Unpaid

cases.title: Mark as paid offline: reference + note required, duplicate reference refused, extends the registration
cases.expected: Active, expiry = max(expiry, payment) + 12 months, visible again; same reference refused

cases.title: Grace keeps the shop working; after grace it is hidden and gets no new orders
cases.steps: Shop 3 days and 30 days past expiry
cases.expected: Grace shop found; expired shop hidden from the shop page and search, closed to new orders

cases.title: Reminder by e-mail, push and in-app on Android (app 1.14.0)
cases.preconditions: Android phone with the app, shop owner signed in
cases.steps: Send a reminder from the admin screen; tap the push
cases.expected: E-mail (English + Marathi), push and bell item arrive; the push opens the registration page in the app

cases.title: Reminder by e-mail, push and in-app on iPhone (app 1.14.0)
Pay a renewal link on staging (sandbox) and see it active at once
cases.steps: Create a link; pay it with the Sandbox payment workflow
cases.expected: Link PAID, status Active, expiry +12 months, confirmation push + e-mail with receipt

cases.title: Production: test payment of a registration / renewal link, then refund
cases.steps: Owner pays a small link with their own card / UPI, then refunds it
cases.expected: Shop active after payment; refund recorded; no test data on production
